notes.title: Necrophobia 1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]NECROPHOBIA 1.2[/h1][p][/p][h3]Rhythm game fix!:[/h3][list][*][p]Notes within the rhythm games no longer desync from music! Additionally, a "hit" and/or "miss" indicator has been added for extra clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Both rhythm games now accept "X" as well as "Z" as inputs (clearing up the issue of the second game and the wonky double tap notes).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Remastered tracks!:[/h3][p]Songs that have been remastered:[/p][list][*][p]I trust you.[/p][/*][*][p]It won't last forever![/p][/*][*][p]Sanctuary. (Asylum pt.2)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]ONE typographical error!:[/h3][p]You heard me right- JUST one. Ironically, the error was spelling "stupid" as "supid". (Guess who's route this was in? notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
The problem regarding the "missing executable" popup when attempting to open the game on Mac has now been resolved, and the game opens as it should.

That's all for now-
Until we meet again~

notes.title: Necrophobia 1st Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[h1]HERE'S TO ONE YEAR!![/h1]
It's been a whole year since the release of Necrophobia! To say that I appreciate the support I've seen thus far would be a heavy understatement~ 
For the week of April 19th, Necrophobia will be 50% off, and from April 19th-23rd, a giveaway will be hosted where 5 lucky winners will obtain a free copy of the game!

[h1]GIVEAWAY INFO[/h1]
Participate here on the pinned post at my Twitter/Instagram while it lasts!
Twitter: https://x.com/_SapphireComics
Insta: https://www.instagram.com/sapphire_comics/

Until we meet again~
